cards.ex: In my view, the new policy is a step in the right direction.
cards.exUz: Mening fikrimcha, yangi siyosat to'g'ri yo'nalishdagi qadamdir.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy fikrimni ifodalash, o'z nuqtai nazarimni aytish.

cards.ex: I reckon it's going to rain later, so take an umbrella.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, keyinroq yomg'ir yog'adi, shuning uchun soyabon oling.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy fikr bildirish, nimagadir ishonch bildirish.

cards.ex: As far as I'm concerned, he's the best candidate for the job.
cards.exUz: Men uchun u ish uchun eng yaxshi nomzod.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy fikrni qat'iy ifodalash, shaxsiy nuqtai nazarim bo'yicha.

cards.ex: I have a hunch that she's not telling us the whole story.
cards.exUz: Menda sezgi bor, u bizga butun hikoyani aytmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida intuitiv his qilish, aniq dalilsiz ishonch.

cards.ex: You should take his advice with a grain of salt; he's not always right.
cards.exUz: Siz uning maslahatini ehtiyotkorlik bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak; u har doim ham haq emas.
cards.term: Take it with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: Xabarni to'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: I'm convinced of her innocence; she would never do that.
cards.exUz: Men uning begunohligiga aminman; u hech qachon bunday qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir to'liq ishonch hosil qilish, amin bo'lish.

cards.ex: He has a firm belief in the power of education.
cards.exUz: U ta'limning kuchiga qat'iy ishonadi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va o'zgarmas ishonchga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Even when challenged, she stuck to her guns and defended her research.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u o'z so'zida turdi va o'z tadqiqotini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini qat'iy himoya qilish, o'z pozitsiyasida turish.

cards.ex: I was going to stay home, but I changed my mind and went to the party.
cards.exUz: Men uyda qolmoqchi edim, lekin fikrimni o'zgartirdim va ziyofatga bordim.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi fikrdan boshqa fikrga kelish.

cards.ex: I have my doubts about whether this plan will actually work.
cards.exUz: Bu reja haqiqatan ham ish berishiga shubham bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida ishonchsizlik hissi, shubha qilish.

cards.ex: Whether this movie is good or bad is just a matter of opinion.
cards.exUz: Bu filmning yaxshi yoki yomonligi faqat fikr masalasi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat shaxsiy fikrga bog'liq bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: For all I know, he might be on vacation.
cards.exUz: Bilishimcha, u ta'tilda bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Men biladigan narsaga asoslanib, ehtimolni taxmin qilish.

cards.ex: To my knowledge, the project is still on schedule.
cards.exUz: Bilishim bo'yicha, loyiha hali ham rejalashtirilgan muddatda.
cards.uzDef: Men biladigan ma'lumotga asoslanib.

cards.ex: He offered the deal in good faith, believing it was the best option.
cards.exUz: U bitimni halol niyat bilan taklif qildi, bu eng yaxshi variant deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Halol va samimiy niyat bilan, yolg'onsiz.

cards.ex: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong, even though I couldn't explain why.
cards.exUz: Menda nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligi haqida ichki sezgi bor edi, garchi men buni tushuntira olmasam ham.
cards.uzDef: Intuisiya, sababsiz paydo bo'lgan his.

cards.ex: I dare say, the weather will improve by tomorrow.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, ob-havo ertaga yaxshilanadi.
cards.uzDef: Taxmin qilish, fikrni bildirish.

cards.ex: I was under the impression that the meeting had been canceled.
cards.exUz: Men uchrashuv bekor qilingan deb o'ylagandim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri fikrda bo'lish, noto'g'ri tushunchaga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: You'll have to take my word for it; I saw it with my own eyes.
cards.exUz: Siz mening so'zimga ishonishingiz kerak; men buni o'z ko'zim bilan ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining aytganiga ishonish, dalilsiz qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Bear in mind that the deadline is next Friday.
cards.exUz: Esda tutingki, oxirgi muddat kelasi juma kuni.
cards.uzDef: Eslab qolish, diqqat bilan esda saqlash.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions; let's hear what she has to say first.
cards.exUz: Xulosa qilishga shoshilmang; avval uning nima deyishini eshitaylik.
cards.uzDef: Tezda, yetarli dalilsiz xulosa chiqarish.

cards.ex: It stands to reason that if you study hard, you'll get good grades.
cards.exUz: Mantiqan to'g'riki, agar yaxshi o'qisangiz, yaxshi baho olasiz.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqiy bo'lish, o'z-o'zidan tushunarli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm trying to figure out what the best course of action is.
cards.exUz: Men eng yaxshi harakat yo'nalishi nima ekanligini tushunishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimani anglash, muammoni yechish.

cards.ex: I have a sneaking suspicion that he's hiding something from us.
cards.exUz: Menda yashirin shubha bor, u bizdan nimadir yashiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Yashirin, noaniq shubha hissi.

cards.ex: They don't always see eye to eye on political issues.
cards.exUz: Ular har doim siyosiy masalalarda bir xil fikrda bo'lishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: The movie gave us a lot of food for thought about the future of technology.
cards.exUz: Film bizga texnologiyaning kelajagi haqida o'ylash uchun ko'p sabab berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga, muhokama qilishga arziydigan narsa.

cards.ex: Employees should have a say in decisions that affect their jobs.
cards.exUz: Xodimlar o'z ishlariga ta'sir qiluvchi qarorlarda fikr bildirish huquqiga ega bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishda ishtirok etish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: If you want my two cents, I think you should go for it.
cards.exUz: Agar mening fikrimni xohlasangiz, menimcha siz harakat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy fikrni arzon va oddiy tarzda ifodalash.

cards.ex: We need to take into account all the factors before making a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin barcha omillarni hisobga olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hisobga olish, e'tiborga olish.

cards.ex: I said I couldn't come, but on second thought, I think I can make it.
cards.exUz: Men kelolmayman dedim, lekin yana bir bor o'ylab, menimcha, kelishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi o'ylab, avvalgi fikrni o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: He may seem tough, but at heart, he's a kind person.
cards.exUz: U qo'pol ko'rinishi mumkin, lekin aslida u mehribon inson.
cards.uzDef: Asl mohiyatda, ichki dunyoda.
